name: RVCP
desc: A rugged, fanless 4G dual-SIM cellular gateway on MediaTek MT7621 with 4 Gigabit Ethernet ports, SFP uplink, and advanced multi-WAN failover running OpenWRT Linux. Ideal for primary WAN failover, remote SCADA connectivity, and distributed IoT metering deployments.
cpu: MediaTek MT7621, Dual Core MIPS 880 MHz
dims: 190 x 30 x 100 mm (W x H x D)
use_cases: Primary WAN Failover for Retail & Branch Offices
Fleet of Distributed IoT/Metering Gateways with Centralized Management
